Care for every kind of recovery

From everyday aches to specialized rehabilitation, our clinic offers five areas of care — book any of them through our online booking page.

Physiotherapy

Assessment and hands-on treatment for pain, injury and movement problems — combining manual therapy with guided exercise to restore strength, mobility and function.

Book physiotherapy →

Massage Therapy

Therapeutic hands-on work on muscles and soft tissue to ease tension and soreness, support recovery from injury, and help you relax and move more comfortably.

Book massage therapy →

TMJ Treatment

Care for jaw pain and stiffness related to the temporomandibular joint — the joint that connects your jaw to your skull — including pain when chewing, clicking, and tension that can contribute to headaches.

Book TMJ treatment →

Vestibular Rehab

Specialized therapy for dizziness, vertigo and balance problems arising from the inner ear — using targeted exercises to retrain balance and reduce feelings of unsteadiness.

Book vestibular rehab →

Dry Needling

A technique that uses fine, sterile needles in tight, tender points within a muscle to release tension, ease pain and improve how the muscle works — often combined with other physiotherapy care.

Book dry needling →

A neighbourhood clinic on Centre Street North

Centre North Physiotherapy Clinic is a physiotherapy and massage clinic in Highland Park, at 4807 Centre St NW in Calgary. The team is led by Kalid, the clinic's lead physiotherapist and team leader.

Care here spans physiotherapy and massage therapy, along with TMJ treatment, vestibular rehab and dry needling — so whether you're recovering from an injury, managing ongoing pain, or working through dizziness and balance issues, there's a path to care under one roof.
